call_points.text: Order inflow guidance of ₹1,600 Cr for FY27, excluding the Uttam order.
EBITDA margins expected similar to last year with a positive delta; no specific band committed.
Interest cost fell in Q1 because positive cash at FY26-end meant minimal overdraft use.
Management said it will not dilute equity for working capital, citing positive operating cash flow.
Q1 revenue slipped on inspection issues, specification proof and supply chain delays; management expects catch-up in Q3 and Q4.
Working capital is expected to stay similar to last year, with pressure building in Q3 and Q4.
S.G. Reddy is stepping down as Managing Director, handing over to M.V. Reddy and Atim Kabra.
Annual maintenance capex of ₹40-50 Cr expected to continue; no major new outlay needed for growth targets.
Board in-principle approved demerger of Space, Meteorology, and Hydrology business to sharpen focus.
Negotiations for Uttam AESA radar orders with HAL are in final stages, expected in Q2 or Q3.
Working capital realization of long-held debtors improved FY26 cash flows; trend expected to continue.
